blocks.x: Let me know if you're getting enough of this. We've done...
Are we going to go up there and eat a little early?

I'd like to get a little more of that sirloin inside me this time, and tell them to save the rest of it, put my name on it, you know. Somebody else got food to (?) to his dog last night or something. Great! He gave me a piece of sirloin, a prime rib that was beautiful! I don't like to play on a full stomach, you know. And I had my timing right. I didn't realize we had another whole hour...
Do you hit at 8:30 and play until 12:30, and then on
Friday and Saturday it will be nine...
I think Carolyn Keene is going to come back tonight with Herb Wong.
He's in town. She was very impressed.

...that's what I keep telling myself, is I'm going to the union in the morning, fixing my tie. "I am in the music business, and music is great. Too bad I can't play." That's Ray Lind's(?) famous line.
